Main.sentence: Ferguson is a city in ___E:St. Louis County U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Louis_County,_Missouri)___ , ___E:Missouri U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Missouri)___ , United States.

It is part of the ___E:Greater St. Louis U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greater_St._Louis)___ metropolitan area. Per the ___E:2020 census U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_United_States_census)___ , the population was 18,527, and is predominantly Black.

What is now the city of Ferguson was founded in 1855, when William B. Ferguson deeded 10 acres (4.0 ha) of land to the ___E:Wabash Railroad U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wabash_Railroad)___ in exchange for a new depot and naming rights.
The settlement that sprang up around the depot was called Ferguson Station.
Ferguson was the first railroad station connected directly to ___E:St. Louis U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Louis)___ .
The station is a focal point of the city's history and is depicted on the city flag, designed in 1994.
Ferguson's first schoolhouse was built in 1878. Ferguson was incorporated as a city in 1894.
___E:Emerson Electric U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emerson_Electric)___ moved its headquarters to Ferguson during the 20th century.

Ferguson made frequent worldwide headlines for months following the 2014 ___E:killing of Michael Brown Jr. U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shooting_of_Michael_Brown)___ by a police officer and the ensuing ___E:civil unrest U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferguson_unrest)___ .

The ___E:United States Department of Justice U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_Justice)___ investigation which followed resulted in large legal fees for the town, in excess of $300,000 a year. The investigation determined that the shooting was justified.
Ferguson elected its first Black and first female mayor, ___E:Ella Jones U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ella_Jones)___ , on June 2, 2020.
The population of Ferguson grew rapidly during the late nineteenth century.
In 1880 the population of the then Ferguson Station was 185 people.
By 1890 the population was recorded as being 750 and only four years later it had increased to 1200.
The population of Ferguson continued to grow rapidly during the first six decades of the twentieth century, from 1,015 people in 1900 to 22,149 people in 1960, an average growth rate of 5% per year.
The ethnic composition of Ferguson has shifted, however.
In 1970, 99% of the population of Ferguson was white and 1% ___E:Black U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/African_Americans)___ .
In 1980, the proportion of white residents went down to 85%, whereas the proportion of Black residents rose to 14%.
In 1990, residents of Ferguson who were identified in the U.S.
Census as white comprised 73.8% of the total, while those identified as Black made up 25.1%.
The remainder, 1.1%, identified with other racial categories.
In the 2000 U.S.
Census, the city shifted to majority African American at 52.4% of the population  (52.30% non-Hispanic African American).
The ___E:2020 United States census U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020_United_States_census)___  counted 18,527 people, 8,844 households, and 5,272 families in Ferguson.
The population density was 3,002.8 per square mile (1,159.4/km 2 ).
There were 10,079 housing units at an average density of 1,633.5 per square mile (630.7/km 2 ).

The racial makeup was 21.4% (3,965) ___E:white U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_(U.S._Census))___ , 72.15% (13,367) ___E:Black or African-American U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/African_American_(U.S._Census))___ , 0.24% (45) ___E:Native American U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Native_American_(U.S._Census))___ , 0.53% (99) ___E:Asian U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asian_(U.S._Census))___ , 0.05% (9) ___E:Pacific Islander U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pacific_Islander_(U.S._Census))___ , 1.31% (243) from ___E:other races U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Race_(United_States_Census))___ , and 4.31% (799) from two or more races. ___E:Hispanic U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_(U.S._Census))___ or ___E:Latino U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latino_(U.S._Census))___ of any race was 1.5% (316) of the population.
Of the 8,844 households, 25.7% had children under the age of 18; 23.9% were married couples living together; 50.2% had a female householder with no husband present.
Of all households, 36.4% consisted of individuals and 10.9% had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or older.
The average household size was 2.3 and the average family size was 3.0.
29.4% of the population was under the age of 18, 10.2% from 18 to 24, 31.7% from 25 to 44, 25.9% from 45 to 64, and 14.0% who were 65 years of age or older.
The median age was 34.3 years.
For every 100 females, the population had 76.0 males.
For every 100 females ages 18 and older, there were 68.6 males.

The 2016-2020 5-year ___E:American Community Survey U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Community_Survey)___  estimates show that the median household income was $37,376 (with a margin of error of +/- $5,435) and the median family income was $44,123 (+/- $8,219).
Males had a median income of $29,652 (+/- $2,440) versus $27,351 (+/- $3,102) for females.
The median income for those above 16 years old was $28,414 (+/- $2,545).

Approximately, 21.4% of families and 23.6% of the population were below the ___E:poverty line U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poverty_line)___ , including 41.2% of those under the age of 18 and 8.1% of those ages 65 or over.

As of the ___E:2010 U.S. census U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_United_States_Census)___ ,  there were 21,203 people, 8,192 households, and 5,500 families residing in the city. The ___E:population density U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Population_density)___ was 3,425.4 inhabitants per square mile (1,322.6/km 2 ).
There were 9,105 housing units at an average density of 1,470.9 per square mile (567.9/km 2 ).

The racial makeup of the city was 67.4% ___E:Black U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_(U.S._Census))___ , 29.3% ___E:white U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_people)___ , 0.5% ___E:Asian U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asian_American)___ , 0.4% ___E:Native American U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Native_Americans_in_the_United_States)___ , 0.4% from ___E:other races U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Race_and_ethnicity_in_the_United_States_Census)___ , and 2.0% from two or more races. ___E:Hispanic and Latino U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans)___ of any race were 1.2% of the population.

There were 8,192 households, of which 39.1% had children under the age of 18 living with them, 29.6% were ___E:married couples U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marriage)___ living together, 31.5% had a female householder with no husband present, 6.1% had a male householder with no wife present, and 32.9% were non-families. 28.2% of all households were made up of individuals, and 7.4% had someone living alone who was 65 years of age or older.
The average household size was 2.56 and the average family size was 3.12.

The median age in the city was 33.1 years. 28.7% of residents were under the age of 18; 10.4% were between the ages of 18 and 24; 25.2% were from 25 to 44; 25.3% were from 45 to 64; and 10.3% were 65 years of age or older.
The gender makeup of the city was 44.8% male and 55.2% female.

According to the ___E:United States Census Bureau U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Census_Bureau)___ , the city has a total area of 6.20 square miles (16.06 km 2 ), of which 6.19 square miles (16.03 km 2 ) is land and 0.01 square miles (0.03 km 2 ) is water.

Ferguson has a borderline ___E:humid subtropical U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Humid_subtropical_climate)___ - ___E:continental climate U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Humid_continental_climate)___ .
Winters are cold, while summers are hot and humid.
The record high is 115 °F, and the record low is −19 °F.

The City of Ferguson was home to the headquarters of Fortune 500 Company ___E:Emerson Electric U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emerson_Electric)___   up until early February 2025, when the Company unveiled "Emerson Tower" as the new Global Headquarters in ___E:Clayton, MO U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clayton,_Missouri)___ .

The ___E:Mayor U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayor)___ of Ferguson is ___E:directly elected U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Direct_election)___ for a three-year term.  The Ferguson ___E:city council U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_government_in_the_United_States#City_councils)___ is composed of six members.

___E:James Knowles III U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Knowles_III)___ was elected mayor for a three-year term in April 2011 and ran unopposed in April 2014.  ___E:Voter turnout U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voter_turnout)___ in the April 2014 mayoral election was approximately 12%.
In June 2020, ___E:Ella Jones U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ella_Jones)___ (D) became the first African American and first woman to be elected mayor of Ferguson.

The ___E:Ferguson Police Department U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferguson_Police_Department_(Missouri))___ is involved with the following public programs: Business Watch, Community Emergency Response Team (CERT), ___E:D.A.R.E. U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drug_Abuse_Resistance_Education)___ Program, ___E:Neighborhood Watch U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neighborhood_Watch)___ , ___E:School Resource Officers U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/School_resource_officer)___ , and Riot Patrol.
Ferguson also operates a two-station fire department with a complement of 18 full-time firefighters as well as nine senior management officials.
The fire stations operate 24 hours a day.

On March 4, 2015, the Ferguson Police Department was criticized by the ___E:United States Department of Justice U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_Justice)___ for civil rights violations.

The Department of Justice argued that the Ferguson Police Department and the City of Ferguson relied on unconstitutional practices in order to balance the city's budget through racially motivated excessive fines and punishments.

On March 11, 2015, Ferguson Police Chief Thomas Jackson stated he was willing to resign, likely later that day (though no timeframe was confirmed) if he could get assurances that the Ferguson Police Department would be left in place and would not be dissolved; ___E:Fox News U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fox_News)___ said he was not pushed out or fired.

His resignation followed City Manager John Shaw who resigned March 10, and Municipal Judge ___E:Ronald Brockmeyer U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ronald_Brockmeyer&action=edit&redlink=1)___ , who resigned March 9. Shaw had ultimate oversight over the Police Department and other city departments and was the most powerful civic official in Ferguson.
He faced criticism for not doing enough to ameliorate the situation.
The week before, three Ferguson Police Department employees were fired for offensive emails mentioned in the Justice Department report.
The Ferguson Fire Department is a ___E:Career fire department U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Full-time_job)___ and provides 24/7 fire and emergency medical services to the City of Ferguson.

The Department hosts one frontline ___E:Rescue Pumpers U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fire_engine#Conventional_fire_engine)___ and one ___E:Turntable Ladder U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fire_engine#Turntable_ladder)___ across two stations, one in the Northeast of the City (Station No. 2) and one in the City Center (Station No. 1) neighboring the Police Department and Municipal Courts building.

The current Station No. 1 was built in 2015, prior the Department's Station No. 1 was housed out of an extension of the City Hall on Church Street, during this time the Department's Ladder was too large to fit into the station bay and was usually kept outside in the rear parking lot, this extension is now home to FYI Backbay, a Youth Organization.
The Department also served the City of Kinloch when the Kinloch Fire Protection District's sole Pumper was unavailable up until 2021 when the District added a second Pumper into their fleet.

On August 9, 2014, an 18-year-old, ___E:Michael Brown U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shooting_of_Michael_Brown)___ , was fatally shot by Darren Wilson with the ___E:Ferguson Police Department U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferguson_Police_Department_(Missouri))___ after an encounter with the officer that led to an altercation and subsequent pursuit.
The incident sparked ___E:riots and acts of vandalism U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferguson_unrest)___ in Ferguson as well as widespread calls for an investigation into the incident.
On August 10, after a day of vigils, there were looting of businesses, arson, vandalism of vehicles, shots fired at firemen and violent clashes between rioters and police.

On August 18, reservists from the ___E:Missouri National Guard U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Missouri_National_Guard)___ arrived in Ferguson at the request of the ___E:Governor of Missouri U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Governors_of_Missouri)___ ___E:Jay Nixon U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jay_Nixon)___ , who also ended midnight to 5:00 a.m. curfews that had been imposed.
On November 24, a grand jury decided that it would not indict Wilson in the shooting death of Brown.
Following the announcement of the grand jury's decision, there was more rioting.
___E:St. Louis Community College-Florissant Valley U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St._Louis_Community_College-Florissant_Valley)___ , which has about 8,000 students, is located in Ferguson.
Much of the community is within the ___E:Ferguson-Florissant School District U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferguson-Florissant_School_District)___ (FFSD).
Primary schools (grades K-2) serving sections of Ferguson include Central, Bermuda, Holman, and Walnut Grove.
Intermediate schools (grade 3-5) serving sections of Ferguson include Lee-Hamilton, Griffith, and Berkeley.

Zoned secondary schools with attendance boundaries that coincide with Ferguson include Johnson-Wabash 6th Grade Center, Ferguson Middle School, and ___E:McCluer High School U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McCluer_High_School)___ .

A portion of Ferguson is instead in the ___E:Riverview Gardens School District U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverview_Gardens_School_District)___ ,   and another is in the ___E:Hazelwood School District U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hazelwood_School_District)___ .

The ___E:Ferguson Municipal Public Library U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ferguson_Municipal_Public_Library)___ is one of several independent community libraries in St. Louis County and is a member of the ___E:Municipal Library Consortium of St. Louis County U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Municipal_Library_Consortium_of_St._Louis_County)___ .
